ILX::call
Description
Make a call to a method defined within the plugin extension referenced
by the handle. Provide the method with the arguments listed in ARGS, do
not continue processing the iRule until a response is received. If the
node method returns a javascript array or dictionary then a Tcl list
object is returned from
ILX
::
call
, otherwise a Tcl string object is returned.
The default timeout value is 3000ms. Use the ‘-timeout’ flag to modify
this.
Note: Whereas the ILX commands were introduced in 12.0, they were not
available until 12.1 without an EA license.
Syntax
ILX
::
call
<
ILX
handle
>
[
-timeout
n
]
<
method
>
[
optional
arg
]
+
n is in milliseconds
Return Value
The return value is the argument passed to response.reply() call on
the extension side (eg. an array, a string, etc).
Valid During
ANY_EVENT
Examples
when
CLIENT_ACCEPTED
{
# Get a handle to the running extension instance to call into.
set
RPC_HANDLE
[
ILX
::
init
my_plugin
my_extension
]
# Make the call and store the response in $rpc_response
set
rpc_response
[
ILX
::
call
$RPC_HANDLE
my_js_function
arg1
arg2
]
}
